00_setup.title: Setup and model inventory
00_setup.proves: Live model IDs and limits from the Models API, so every other lab uses real strings.

01_response_anatomy.title: Response anatomy
01_response_anatomy.proves: stop_reason arrives on a 200, content is a list of blocks, and system is a parameter, not a role.

02_caching.title: Prompt caching, and how to destroy it
02_caching.proves: Your own cache hit rate collapsing because one timestamp entered the prefix.

03_tools.title: A tool loop with failures
03_tools.proves: The model self-correcting from is_error, and tool selection degrading as the toolset grows.

04_batch.title: Batch and the custom_id join
04_batch.proves: Batch results arrive unordered; a positional join silently mislabels rows.

05_streaming.title: Streaming events
05_streaming.proves: Final usage lives in message_delta, and an error can arrive after the 200.

06_structured_output.title: Structured output: fabrication versus null
06_structured_output.proves: One schema change (nullable fields) stops the model inventing values.

07_tokens_and_migration.title: Tokens and model migration
07_tokens_and_migration.proves: Token counts differ per model, and which parameters now return 400.

08_mcp_server.title: An MCP server over stdio
08_mcp_server.proves: All three MCP primitives (tools, resources, prompts) over stdio, with no API cost.

09_hooks.title: A hook that blocks
09_hooks.proves: Exit 2 blocks the action; exit 1 fails open. Request versus control, made concrete.

10_eval_harness.title: An eval harness
10_eval_harness.proves: A prompt fix that repairs one case and breaks two others, caught by an eval set.
